content:
[L] high | right Copilot panel header | The "Local" button and "✕" close button overlap/collide with the "Copilot" title and the "local - no configuration needed" caption, producing three overlapping elements at the panel top.
[L] high | Copilot panel, suggested reply card | The "Suggested reply" body text is clipped at the bottom of the panel — the closing line "before sending.]" is cut mid-sentence at the window edge.
[L] high | conversation list, row 1 (Amy Fraughton) | The "Closed" chip sits at the row's bottom-right corner colliding with the selected-row highlight boundary, crammed against the row edge instead of inside its padding.
[S] med | reading pane header vs. card | The conversation title block ("#501 Re:…") is left-aligned at a different x-offset than the "Status" card below it, so the header and card edges do not share a grid.
[S] med | list filter toolbar | The search input, "#" chip, and black "Apply" button have inconsistent heights and vertical centers; the "Filters / Reset / Sync now" row's label baseline does not align with the buttons to its right.
[S] med | Status card rows | Horizontal gaps between pill groups vary (active/pending/closed/spam vs. low/normal/high/urgent vs. the 7-item state row), and the "State" row is stretched nearly full width while other rows hug left — no consistent rhythm.
[S] med | Copilot signals card | "Bug report" is a filled chip while "urgency: low" and "sentiment: positive" are plain colored text at different sizes — three different treatments for peer metadata in one card.
[H] med | conversation rows | Sender name, subject line, timestamp, "Unassigned", and "Closed" all render at near-equal weight and size; nothing distinguishes the primary subject from metadata, unlike a proper list row hierarchy.
[H] med | reading pane | Inline "sentiment: positive" label floats alone between the card and the date separator at the same visual weight as body content, duplicating the Signals card info with no grouping.
[C] med | conversation list | Roughly half the list column is empty dead whitespace below two rows with no empty-state treatment or content, unbalanced against the dense reading pane.
[C] med | reading pane, date "2026-10-16" | The transcript area shows only a lone date separator with zero message content between the properties card and the composer — the conversation body is empty, reading like an unfinished/debug view.
[C] low | top toolbar | The "Closed" chip, "Copilot" button, and spinner cluster at top-right is cramped and misaligned with the title baseline, and the mouse cursor sits overlapping the Copilot panel header.
[H] low | Summary card | The last bullet duplicates the previous bullet verbatim ("How do I give them full access…"), indicating unpolished generated content presented as authoritative.
[S] low | composer To/Cc/Bcc | Row label-to-input gaps and input widths are inconsistent (To field unlabeled-box vs. Cc/Bcc boxed placeholders), and the bottom hint text sits far from the Send button with uneven padding.

VERDICT: unprofessional — overlapping controls in the Copilot header, clipped text, duplicated content, and inconsistent row/pill treatments throughout make this read as a prototype, not a product.

Note: the composer correctly spans only the reading column and does not collide with the right panel; the left views rail itself is defect-free.
